about.title: Full-stack, backend first
about.text: I'm a full-stack software engineer with 8+ years of experience and a focus on the backend: APIs, integrations and distributed systems in Node.js and TypeScript, with React and Next.js on the frontend. Today I work on PayPal's Node.js and GraphQL platform.

experience.title: From a PHP monolith to microservices
experience.text: As tech lead at Trocafone, I led the migration of a legacy PHP monolith to microservices in Node.js, Python (FastAPI) and .NET Core, with a GraphQL gateway for unified access to the APIs, deployed with Docker and Kubernetes.

education.title: Computer Science, while already working
education.text: I graduated in Computer Science from Universidade São Judas Tadeu (2018–2022). I started in Computer Engineering at Anhembi Morumbi and switched in 2018, the year I began as a software development intern at Ingenico.

courses.title: Learning alongside the work
courses.text: Besides the degree, I took IGTI's full-stack bootcamp (2021–2022) and Full Cycle courses on Docker, continuous integration, SOLID and software architecture fundamentals (2024–2025).

projects.title: A 30% faster API
projects.text: Reparofone, a device repair management system, was my first full-stack project: React and Redux on the frontend, GraphQL and REST APIs in Laravel with MySQL. Optimizing the resolvers and batching the queries made its API 30% faster.

contributing.title: Beyond the code
contributing.text: Alongside engineering, I volunteer in initiatives for children, families in vulnerable situations and elderly communities: 4+ initiatives and 100+ volunteer hours so far.

contact.title: Open channel
contact.text: I'm based in São Paulo, Brazil, available for travel and relocation, and I work in Portuguese and English. The fastest way to reach me is email or WhatsApp, and my résumé is on the site.

education.title: Ciência da Computação, já trabalhando
education.text: Me formei em Ciência da Computação na Universidade São Judas Tadeu (2018–2022). Comecei em Engenharia da Computação na Anhembi Morumbi e mudei em 2018, o ano em que comecei como estagiário de desenvolvimento na Ingenico.

courses.title: Aprendendo junto com o trabalho
courses.text: Além da faculdade, fiz o bootcamp full-stack do IGTI (2021–2022) e cursos da Full Cycle de Docker, integração contínua, SOLID e fundamentos de arquitetura de software (2024–2025).

projects.title: Uma API 30% mais rápida

contributing.title: Além do código

contact.title: Canal aberto
contact.text: Moro em São Paulo, estou disponível para viagens e mudança e trabalho em português e inglês. O jeito mais rápido de falar comigo é por e-mail ou WhatsApp, e meu currículo está no site.
